images.license: Public domain (own work, generated from public-domain vector data via GMT)
images.usage: The map mystery hook, the class activity, and the printed handout. Cropped from the 2250x1650 original to longitude 12W-30E, latitude 36N-64N.
images.projection: Equirectangular (equidistant cylindrical), a uniform 30 pixels per degree in BOTH directions. So the crop is 1260x840 and a city sits at x = (longitude + 12) * 30, y = (64 - latitude) * 30. That uniform scale is what makes a circumcircle on this image an actual circle rather than an ellipse, and it is why this map was chosen over the prettier relief and conic ones.
